title: Phelps Mansion

services.name: Tours
services.desc: Join us for a brand-new walking tour of downtown Binghamton! Learn about Binghamton’s history as well as current food, arts, and entertainment the city has to offer. Guests can expect about one hour of walking, starting and ending at the Phelps Mansion Museum. Great for local residents and new visitors alike! Tickets can be purchased on-site at the Phelps. $12/adult, $10/student or senior, children 12 and under free. Tours offered all weekend- Friday September 18th at 2pm and Saturday September 19th and Sunday September 20th at 11am. Last chance!
